values.meaning: duration of the mark allowing Resonating Strike to be cast

mechanics.claim: Resonating Strike's damage scales with the target's missing health, from 0% to 100% bonus (i.e. up to double damage) as missing health goes from 0% to 100%.
mechanics.quote: increased by {{pp|key=%|type=target's '''missing''' health|0 to 100 for 11|0 to 100|key1=%|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health|color=health}}

mechanics.claim: Resonating Strike can only be cast on the target marked by Sonic Wave, and only while that target is nearby, consuming the mark on arrival.
mechanics.quote: dashes to the nearby enemy marked by ''{{ai|Sonic Wave|Lee Sin}}''. Upon arrival, he consumes the mark and deals {{as|physical damage}}

mechanics.claim: Sonic Wave's cooldown starts on the initial cast, not after the Resonating Strike recast.
The damage from Resonating Strike can be negated if the target blinks away during the dash.
mechanics.quote: The damage dealt by ''Resonating Strike'' can be negated if the target {{tip|blink|blinks}}.

mechanics.claim: Resonating Strike costs less than Sonic Wave.
